The '''Ulkantha asteroids'''<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> were located in the [[Ulkantha system/Legends|Ulkantha system]], a part of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC Ulkantha" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Ulkantha" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that the [[raid on the Ulkantha asteroids]] was carried out at some point between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which corresponds to the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] carried out a [[Raid on the Ulkantha asteroids|raid]] in the Ulkantha [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. As a result, the Empire's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] known as the [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] learned about an extensive [[Unidentified Sakiyan smuggling ring|Sakiyan smuggling ring]] based at the [[Syvris shadowport]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in the [[Al'Nasrl sector/Legends|Al'Nasrl sector's]] [[Syvris system/Legends|Syvris system]].<ref name="EAOC Syvris">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Syvris system/Legends|Syvris system]]</ref> The Death Squadron subsequently carried out a devastating [[Raid on Syvris shadowport|attack]] on the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ulkantha asteroids were first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ulkantha [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the asteroids, in grid square S-8.<ref name="EAOC Ulkantha" />
